premises.text: Scalable backends require distributed databases, but assembling relational, document, blob, and search stacks and then sharding/replicating is hard
premises.evidence_span: building that today, even today, is really hard. You have to combine a lot of different technologies

premises.text: Crate provides real-time SQL in a distributed elastic data store that is simple to install, run, and program
premises.evidence_span: It gives you real-time SQL in a distributed environment, and unless most of the competition in the modern architecture, which makes it extremely simple to install, run, and program

premises.text: Clusters self-heal when nodes fail while clients keep accessing data
premises.evidence_span: Create doesn't care. It detects a missing node, removes it from the cluster, and immediately starts the self-healing process

premises.text: Deployment spans cloud, on-premise, and even consumer-grade PCs, with language drivers and admin UI
premises.evidence_span: You just install Create on Promise. Or even on consumer-grade PCs
